keyword: how long does it take to fly to the moon
claims: It typically takes about three days for a spacecraft to travel from Earth to the Moon.
Apollo missions generally took just under three days (about 69–75 hours) to enter lunar orbit.
Apollo missions took place in the 1960s-70s.
Apollo 8 reached lunar orbit in 69 hours and 8 minutes.
New Horizons passed the moon in 8.5 hours in 2006.
Artemis I/II missions take 4 to 5 days.
Artemis II is expected to take four to five days for a flyby mission.
